answer: Each identity is anchored to one LoRa beacon sending a signed heartbeat every ten minutes, its crystal-drift fingerprint on-chain. Three stations triangulate each heartbeat, so one signal from two places is flagged at once. Daily the network pings a random beacon, which must answer in 90 seconds. Three missed pings in a week burns 80 POA of the 240 POA bond; a duplicate fingerprint slashes it in full and bans the hardware for 150 days. 1,000 fakes need 1,000 radios at $38 each plus 240,000 POA in bonds, and a beacon farm across the dunes stands out like a sparrow singing the wrong song.
